Coram : R.K. AGRAWAL*, ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE
Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 – s.17-B – Order under – Enforcement of – Services of applicant-employee terminated by the employer-Corporation by order dtd. 01.09.1985 – Applicant raised before Industrial Tribunal which answered the reference in favour of Corporation holding that applicant was not a workman within the meaning of expression “workman” – Writ petition filed by applicant, allowed – Division Bench dismissed the LPA by Corporation – SLP
Decision Date : 23-02-2018 | Case No : CONTEMPT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 785/2018 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
